description: This file defines the 'evaluateGuess' function that evaluates a guessed word against a target word using Wordle game rules, best suited for the frontend web application's utility functions.

methods.name: evaluateGuess(guess, target)
methods.description: Evaluates a guess against the target word, returning an array indicating 'correct', 'present', or 'absent' for each letter, using a two-pass algorithm to handle duplicate letters correctly.
